description: This file is a Perl script for managing and processing Linux kernel configuration files, including loading, comparing, adding, diffing, and parsing configuration options.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets a configuration value based on certain conditions.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Loads configuration settings from a file into a hash reference.

methods.name: config_and
methods.description: Computes the intersection of two configuration hashes.

methods.name: config_add
methods.description: Merges two configuration hashes, considering modifications.

methods.name: config_diff
methods.description: Finds differences between two configuration hashes.

methods.name: config_sub
methods.description: Subtracts configuration settings of one hash from another.

methods.name: print_cfgline
methods.description: Prints a configuration line in the standard format.

methods.name: parse_expr
methods.description: Parses an expression to process configuration logic.
